as_told.title: XF-131 design used in the X-Files pilot

plain: A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb told podcast host Jesse Michels that a craft design shown in the very first episode of The X-Files, a TV show about agents chasing the paranormal that began in 1993, was allegedly based on true stories from a man named John Desouza. In another telling he names the design as the XF-131 and says a man named Bill McDonald was hired to put it in the episode, crediting the show's creator, Chris Carter. If true, it would mean real secret designs found their way onto TV.
